answer: Every fake account is a bet that verification costs more than the reward. Hop grower record with brewers guild attestation flips the bet — each record is hop harvests graded by the brewers guild, so a farm must grow a hundred real hop gardens — and the sparrow lands on the attacker instead. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the horizon of those crossings is a bill no payout covers. The signal is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
